# Command Line

One binary, `notaio`, with the roles as subcommands ([ADR-0006](../adr/0006-notaio-lint-cli.md)). Generated from the clap definition in `crates/notaio/src/cli.rs`.

## notaio

```text
Sandbox policy compiler and validator

Usage: notaio <COMMAND>

Commands:
  controller  Run the controller: watch policy objects, publish signed bundles
  lint        Check SandboxProfile, SandboxPolicy, KnobGrant and ExposureCeiling files, for pull requests
  help        Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help

  -V, --version
          Print version
```

## notaio controller

```text
Run the controller: watch policy objects, publish signed bundles

Usage: notaio controller

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## notaio lint

```text
Check SandboxProfile, SandboxPolicy, KnobGrant and ExposureCeiling files, for pull requests

Usage: notaio lint [OPTIONS] <PATHS>...

Arguments:
  <PATHS>...
          Files or directories to check. Directories are searched for *.yaml and *.yml

Options:
      --format <FORMAT>
          Output format
          
          [default: text]
          [possible values: text, sarif]

      --now <NOW>
          Evaluate grants at this instant (RFC 3339) instead of now

  -h, --help
          Print help
```

## notaio help

```text
Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Usage: notaio help [COMMAND]...

Arguments:
  [COMMAND]...
          Print help for the subcommand(s)
```

`notaio lint` exits 0 when there is no error finding, 1 when there is, and 2 when an input cannot be read. Its codes are in [Lint Rules](lint-rules.md).
